intro: A field written owner?: string can be absent, so reading it can produce undefined. A union such as number | null permits either kind of value. A literal union such as "open" | "done" limits text to named choices. Checking a value before using it narrows the cases the compiler must consider.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: The ?? operator uses its right side for null or undefined. A zero stays zero. The || operator would also replace zero or empty text. typeof input returns a string such as "number" at runtime; checking that string lets the compiler narrow a string | number union inside the branch.
